answers.rationale: FR3 requires explicit method dispatch and only specifies HEAD fallback to GET and OPTIONS Allow behavior. Automatically registering POST when GET is registered would contradict explicit method dispatch.

presented_options.A: exits with code 1 because at least one request was still in flight when the timeout elapsed

answers.rationale: FR10 gives graceful_timeout_s a default of 30 seconds and requires clean exit code 0 after bounded graceful shutdown. Therefore requests still running after about 30 seconds cannot keep the process alive indefinitely.
